__private/platform.rs::PLATFORM.reason: The engine keeps one provider of platform callbacks for registration and profiling; the provider is installed before engine startup.

block/fluid_capability.rs::BUCKET_IDS.reason: Three vanilla bucket identifiers resolved once; no live registration or world state.

block/item_place.rs::fresh::NEXT.reason: Names lent scratch slots without reusing an identity after a transaction or host drops; it stores no stacks or world state.

block/part_state.rs::EDITING.reason: Per-thread stack of the Part-state edits open on this thread, by holder, so an edit of the same holder and key from inside its own edit is refused.

callback_owner.rs::CAUGHT.reason: Per-thread slot holding the attributed diagnostic recorded by the game panic hook during a contained unwind so hostile payload destructors cannot overwrite it.

callback_owner.rs::CONTAINED.reason: Per-thread nesting depth for contain_unwind and CallbackOwner containment so the game panic hook suppresses crash reports and captures diagnostics for contained mod panics.

callback_owner.rs::DELEGATED_ENGINE_PANI.reason: Per-thread handoff for a fatal engine panic raised inside a delegated vanilla HUD body so wrapper containment cannot swallow it before the outermost wrapper exits.

callback_owner.rs::RETAINED_CALLBACK.reason: Per-thread flag marking that a retained mod callback is currently running under CallbackOwner containment so the panic hook knows the unwind will be caught and reported.

client/arm_pose.rs::TEST_POSES.reason: Thread-local test lookup of installed Parts metadata by engine-issued slot.

client/client_reload.rs::model_manager::.reason: Immutable vanilla reload-boundary identifier, allocated once and shared by anchor declarations.

client/particle_keys.rs::resolved::EMPTY.reason: Empty or set-once resolved registry lookup returned when no installed Parts inventory supplies one.

content/crash.rs::CURRENT_CRASH_OWNER.reason: Call and frame ownership stay local to avoid indirect callbacks on every subscribed dispatch; the same cell identifies contained attachment callback panics.

content/registry_keys.rs::ENCHANTMENTS.reason: Resolved engine registry identity lookup, replaced on registry reload; it stores installed slot mappings, not authoring requests.

content/registry_keys.rs::resolved_block.reason: Empty or set-once resolved registry lookup returned when no installed Parts inventory supplies one.

content/registry_keys.rs::resolved_entit.reason: Empty or set-once resolved registry lookup with living type metadata when no installed Parts inventory supplies one.

content/registry_keys.rs::resolved_items.reason: Empty or set-once resolved registry lookup returned when no installed Parts inventory supplies one.

content/registry_keys.rs::resolved_menus.reason: Fallback menu identity lookup before Parts are installed. Installed loads own their menu tables, including fixture registration epochs.

content/registry_keys.rs::share_blocks::.reason: Test installations retain one resolved block table per distinct payload, shared by full equality, so repeated fixtures do not each keep a copy; production builds keep their one install's own table.

content/registry_keys.rs::share_names::S.reason: Test installations retain one registry key table per distinct payload, shared by full equality, so repeated fixtures do not each keep a copy; compiled only for tests and the testing feature, so production builds hold no pool.

dispatch_scope.rs::BACKEND.reason: Set-once platform callback registration; mutable platform storage lives above the engine.

parts/attachment_types.rs::attachment_sy.reason: Per-thread conversion buffers for one attachment's namespace and name while a pairing packet is projected; emptied and refilled on each call, holding no state between calls.

parts/block_entities.rs::resolved_block_.reason: Empty or set-once resolved registry lookup returned when no installed Parts inventory supplies one.

parts/blocks.rs::LISTEN_SCOPE.reason: Per-thread listen snapshot a tick phase's worker answers routing questions from, in force only for the phase's work.

parts/datapack_registries.rs::PROCESS_DE.reason: Compiled only under cfg(any(test, feature = "testing")), never in a production build. Set once with installed datapack-registry declarations so connection tests on other threads can look them up; holds no live authoring requests.

parts/effects.rs::resolved_effects::EMPT.reason: Empty or set-once resolved registry lookup returned when no installed Parts inventory supplies one.

parts/fluids.rs::resolved_fluids::EMPTY.reason: Empty or set-once resolved registry lookup returned when no installed Parts inventory supplies one.

parts/registration_access.rs::install_in.reason: Names each Parts installation with a number no later installation reuses, so a registry identity never depends on an installation's address.

parts/shared.rs::GAME_PARTS.reason: Per-game lookup table and its world/thread validity context, replaced when world tags change.

parts/shared.rs::INSTALLED.reason: Frozen installed Parts inventory used by engine dispatch and registry lookups.

parts/shared.rs::IN_FEATURE.reason: Per-thread flag keeping a running feature's worldgen Part table stable.

parts/shared.rs::NO_PARTS.reason: Immutable empty lookup result before installation.

parts/shared.rs::TEST_PARTS.reason: Per-thread installed lookup inventory for isolated engine tests.

parts/shared.rs::WORLDGEN_GENERATION.reason: Generation of the published worldgen Part table, read without its lock.

parts/shared.rs::WORLDGEN_PARTS.reason: Part table the server published for world generation, with its generation, replaced at world open and /reload.

parts/shared.rs::WORLDGEN_TABLE.reason: Per-thread handle on the published worldgen Part table and its generation.

parts/shared.rs::requested_keys::EMPTY.reason: Empty or set-once resolved registry lookup returned when no installed Parts inventory supplies one.

runtime.rs::ACTIVE_LISTENERS.reason: Per-thread stack of active non-reentrant hook callbacks so reentering the same listener for the same hook is refused.

runtime.rs::HOOK_DISPATCH_DEPTH.reason: Thread-local depth of active hook panic-containment guards. The crash hook defers only while this call is inside a guarded native dispatch.

runtime.rs::ISOLATED_FAILURES.reason: Per-thread count of trapped listener failures; owning decide/fire/apply actions compare it to decide whether to abort tentative Host writes.

runtime.rs::MODS.reason: Dependency-ordered hook routing and its per-mod enabled bits remain engine-owned.

runtime.rs::MODS_SWITCHED.reason: Counts changes to the per-mod enabled bits it sits beside; read through the host's capability provider table, never by a guest's own copy.

runtime.rs::TEST_MODS.reason: Thread-local dispatch inventory for isolated engine tests.

testing/engine_platform.rs::PLATFORM.reason: Compiled only under the testing feature, never in a production build. Set once by the platform crate's test support with the callbacks engine test fixtures need (game key registration, the parts fixture, running with installed mods), so engine crates reach them without depending on the platform; holds no live authoring requests.

world/inside_write.rs::SPARE_SWEEP.reason: Per-thread reusable inside-block collector storage, lent exclusively to one sweep and returned empty; a nested sweep takes its own, and no callback runs under the borrow.

world/scheduler.rs::allocate::NEXT_ID.reason: Monotonic generator for TaskId cancellation handles so scheduled task IDs are unique across worlds and never reused.

world/server_reload.rs::functions_ref::I.reason: Immutable vanilla reload-boundary identifier, allocated once and shared by anchor declarations.

world/startup_progress.rs::SCREEN.reason: One engine-installed startup-screen service; registration contexts carry this same resource to mods, and retained progress handles use it after registration.

world/startup_progress.rs::TEST_SCREEN.reason: Thread-local startup screen override lent to registration fixtures and restored on scope exit.

world/ticket_controller.rs::NEXT_TOKEN.reason: Monotonic sequence counter mixed into opaque TicketController registration tokens so no handle identity is reused.

world/ticket_controller.rs::TEST_CONTROL.reason: Thread-local test lookup of installed Parts metadata by engine-issued slot.

world/ticket_controller.rs::issue_token:.reason: Per-process random salt mixed into opaque TicketController registration tokens; initialized once and immutable.

world/ticket_controller.rs::take_for_sta.reason: One-shot latch ensuring installed TicketActivation startup authority can only be claimed once before native mods load.
